::: {.hero-panel}
This study uses LTA's September 2026 train trips to ask how the Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line Phase 1 might change the stations chosen by existing rail users. The proposed network adds 29 distinct station locations. The ridership comparison holds today's origin trips fixed, so it describes a redistribution under stated assumptions rather than total future demand.
:::

## Scope and findings

The [Exercise 3 brief](https://isss626-ay2026-27aug.netlify.app/take-home_ex03) asks for current and proposed interaction tables, observed station ridership, a fitted choice model and a market-area comparison. This is one Exercise 3 submission. The station list includes the three Circle Line Stage 6 stations opened in July 2026, giving **184 current physical station locations**. The brief's 24 JRL and 12 CRL1 codes add **29 new locations** after existing interchanges are reconciled.

Among **13,436 completed HDB blocks**, **9,676** have centroids within 800 m of a current station. The proposed stations bring another **1,319 blocks** inside that straight-line threshold. This is a building proximity screen; it does not count residents or actual walking routes.

The September 2026 LTA OD extract supplies **66.78 million weekday trips** after excluding 238 same-station trips. All recorded station codes match the updated station list. A separate LTA station-volume file reports **67.42 million weekday tap-outs**; the OD destination sum is 99.05% of that figure. I use the OD totals without scaling away the discrepancy.

The fitted model assigns **6.29 million** of the fixed current-origin trips to proposed destinations. That number is highly conditional. Its in-sample station error averages **237,987 trips**, and its station-level R² is **0.23**. Seven existing interchanges gain trips only when the model gives their added line an attraction uplift; without that uplift, they lose share like the other existing stations. The [technical report](Take-home_Ex03-report.qmd) puts these checks beside the maps and rankings.

## Reproduce the analysis

The [README](https://github.com/davincuaso/ISSS608-VAA/blob/master/Take-home_Ex/Take-home_Ex03/README.md) records data sources, exact commands and checksums. The preparation script downloads public HDB, land-use and bus-stop layers. LTA's monthly trip extracts require an account key and are kept in the excluded private-data folder; the published repository holds only derived aggregate results.
